Switch on with all dials at minimum moves the dot to y=10, leaving x and size unchanged [E2]
Dial a moves the dot in x and increases size: a=5 gives x=10 and size=3.5, suggesting x=2a and size=1+0.5a [E3]
How dials b and c affect the reading is still unknown?
How the switch combines with nonzero dials is still unknown?
